note: Apocalypse run (Dom, 28 Oct 2026): an opt-in 12 minute run of three stages on the existing zones. The default game stays the open sandbox; a run starts from the hub's menu button or ?run=1 and ?norun=1 turns the whole mode off. engine/apocalypse-run.js is the director: it reads the game clock, moves through the stages, fires each stage's raids through the post-boss raid (engine/post-boss-raid.js, capped by postBossRaid.maxSimultaneous) and scales the heat gain (engine/heat.js). The run seed (the day plus the run count, see spawn-variation.js) picks one row of each variants list, so every run differs in objective, assault size and hazard. Client-only and session-only: g.run is never saved or sent.

stages.bannerLine: Loot and explore. The heat is low.
The hunters are coming for you.
End it. Kill the boss or reach the safehouse.

scavenge.objective: Search the roads for crates. Stay quiet.
Find weapons and rounds. Avoid fights.
Stock up on dressings and ammunition.

assault.objective: Hunters are sweeping the roads. Hold out.
A swarm is coming. Keep moving.
A siege. Make a stand and thin them out.

finale.objective: A boss has found you. Kill it.

extraction.note: The escape row is one timed zone (Dom, 30 Oct 2026): a circle at the mouth of the exit home in each raid zone; stand in it holdSeconds and the run ends with the bonus.
extraction.note2: A flare marks it; stepping in calls a raid and the area boss walks to it (converge.js, the airdrop pull). holdDecayPerSecond 0 = leaving never drains it.
extraction.note3: The bonus is a session-only score on the results card, never cash. ?noextract=1 or enabled false: instant exit.

view.note: First-time-player legibility (Dom's phone pass, 29 Oct 2026): a ground circle at the hold spot the size of holdRadius, and a big progress ring on screen. The ring text is webText extraction.ringLabel.

text.startHint: Twelve minutes: scavenge, survive the invasion, then kill the boss or escape.
